meta.gate_note: 채널 오버라이드 게이트 A~D를 9장 전부 통과. 게이트 A는 일러스트 계열 규정대로 「무연령·무성·무직업 마스코트」가 해결한다(config/thumbnail-illustration.md §1). 구도: 좌우 대비 4장(1·4·6·9) / 은유 장면 2장(2·5) / 현장+정보 패널 1장(3) / 레퍼 계승 3장(7~9, 9는 배경에 좌우 대비를 겹침). 인물 크기는 실사형과 달리 머리 30~40%이며 SCALE 문장을 쓰지 않는다.
meta.ab_test_note: 🧪 이 계열은 2026-08-19 신설된 미검증 계열이다. 실사형 9장과의 A/B 실측이며, 어느 계열을 썼는지와 48시간·7일 조회수·일을 production-queue.md 해당 항목에 반드시 기록한다.
meta.prompt_suffix: Style: a richly rendered, volumetric semi-3D digital illustration in the visual language of Korean finance-explainer YouTube thumbnails — dimensional forms with real weight, believable materials (brushed metal, glass, brick, paper, fabric, gold), soft ambient occlusion and glossy highlights; every surface has thickness, weight and a light side and a shadow side. A golden sunset or a strong warm key light burns behind the scene and floods it with orange and gold, while the opposite side falls into deep near-black shadow, so the tonal range runs from almost pure black to bright highlight inside one frame. Colours are vivid and poster-like: gold and orange for the winning side, saturated red for loss and danger, saturated green for gain. The frame is CROWDED — signboards, floating panels, round badges, bar charts, thick arrows, stacks of gold coins, cash bundles, brand-free office and household props stacked into every part of the upper picture the way a busy movie poster is, and yet the main figure and the main number still read instantly at thumbnail size. CHARACTER SHEET, identical in every image: a large smooth round off-white head with no hair and no nose, rendered with soft three-dimensional shading and a clean dark outline, always the brightest face in the picture; two big white eyes with round black pupils and visible eyelids; thick solid black eyebrows that change angle with the emotion; a drawn mouth that opens and bends with the emotion; a small simple body in situation clothing with simple rounded hands. If the scene contains more than one person, every one of them is the SAME character with the same head, differing only in clothing, pose and expression; many scenes have only one. Render only the Korean and English words quoted above; every other surface stays free of lettering — no invented Korean words, no stray English text, no Latin letters, no fake Chinese characters, no gibberish lettering, no random numbers. No title overlay text, no captions, no subtitle bars, no large lettering across the frame, no watermark.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 한 줄: 「2만 원 차이로 발밑이 갈라진다」 — 파트③ 금융소득종합과세 기준선 2,000만원(14년째 불변)이 근거. [A 얼굴] 마스코트(무연령·무성이라 시청자 전원이 자기를 대입) / [B 금액] "1,999만원" · "2,001만원" / [C 사건] 왼쪽 지면이 지금 갈라지며 발밑이 무너지는 중 / [D 주어] 갈라진 쪽에 서 있는 게 내 돈이다 / [구도] 좌우대비 / [텍스트] 제목은 결과, 썸네일은 경계선 자체
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the illustration fills the entire 16:9 frame edge to edge — never a letterbox band, never an empty panel, never a flat colour block. The bottom three-eighths of the frame height is filled by the dark broken rock ledge in the foreground and the deep near-black shadow pooling under both figures, with no readable detail, so that overlay text stays legible on top of it; the upper five-eighths is bright, warm and high-contrast, flooded with golden orange light and crowded with things to look at. No face, no hand, no panel and no number sits in that bottom three-eighths — every face, hand, signboard and number sits in the upper five-eighths. Ground lines and table tops run across the MIDDLE of the frame, never near the bottom edge. SIZE: each mascot's round head spans roughly 30 percent of the frame height and is the brightest, clearest shape on its side of the picture; the signboards and numbers are drawn far larger than real proportion would allow so the biggest figure reads instantly at thumbnail size. Scene: one wide landscape cut down the middle by a jagged crack in the ground, with a heavy wooden fork-in-the-road signpost standing in the gap. The left world is cold, dark and red: the ground is splitting open right now, slabs of rock tipping and tumbling into the crack, and a huge red panel leans there with a header reading "금융소득" in Korean Hangul above enormous white digits reading "2,001만원". The right world is warm and golden: a paved road runs off into a sunlit horizon, and a green panel carries the header "금융소득" in Korean Hangul above enormous white digits reading "1,999만원", with stacks of gold coins and a bundle of cash piled at its foot. The left mascot wears a worn grey work jacket, its thick black eyebrows angled down and inward in distress, mouth open, a fat sweat drop flying from its temple, one rounded hand clutching an oversized white notice sheet whose header reads "자격상실 안내" in Korean Hangul while the smaller lines beneath are drawn too small and slightly blurred to read, and its feet are sliding as the ledge gives way. The right mascot, the same character, wears a clean suit with flat calm eyebrows and a small confident smile, one rounded hand resting on the gold.

thumbnails.concept_ko: [모순] 다 도달한 자리의 전망이 창 하나 너머에 펼쳐져 있는데, 정작 그 앞은 사람 없이 비어 있고 협탁에 계산서 한 장만 놓여 있다 / [남김] 그 한 줄 모순 · 세로 창틀이 화면을 여러 칸으로 가르는 분할선과 실내·창밖의 경계 · 카메라는 거실 안쪽 앉은 눈높이에서 창을 정면으로 본다 · 인물 0명 + 통유리와 야경이 상단 5/8을 가로로 채우는 배치, 실내 따뜻한 간접조명 vs 창밖 차가운 도시광 / [바꿈] 공간의 성격(과시적 펜트하우스 → 현실적으로 닿는 고층 아파트 거실) · 화면 안 사물(없음 → 창가 협탁 위 방금 뜯긴 11월 통보문) · 관찰 디테일(연출된 장식 → 소파 팔걸이의 낡은 카디건과 식은 찻잔) ※ 카메라 시점은 바꾸지 않았다. 실사형 7번과 같은 앵커·같은 [남김]이며 렌더링만 일러스트다. [A 얼굴] ⛔ 없음 — 001(633,252회·92.8배)이 인물 0명으로 낸 성적이라 이 3장은 §2-A를 의도적으로 비켜 간다. 마스코트도 넣지 않는다(넣으면 001 프레임이 아니다) / [B 금액] ⛔ 없음 — 8번이 게이트 B를 담당한다 / [C 사건] 통보문이 봉투에서 반쯤 빠져나와 말려 올라가는 중, 커튼이 들리는 중 / [D 주어] 저 전망도 저 통보문도 내 것이다 / [구도] 인물 없는 공간 단독 / [텍스트] 001 배치 계승 — 하단 2단, 윗줄 노랑 "20만 원 더 벌었습니다" / 아랫줄 흰색 11월의 계산서
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the illustration fills the entire 16:9 frame edge to edge — never a letterbox band, never an empty panel, never a flat colour block. The bottom three-eighths of the frame height is filled by the dark back and arm of the sofa nearest the viewer and the deep near-black shadow on the floor in front of it, with no readable detail, so that overlay text stays legible on top of it; the upper five-eighths is bright, warm and high-contrast, the interior washed in golden amber and the window band crowded with things to look at. No lamp, no sheet of paper and no bright object sits in that bottom three-eighths — the window wall and every object of interest sit in the upper five-eighths. The side table top runs across the MIDDLE of the frame, never near the bottom edge. NO CHARACTER IN THIS IMAGE: this picture contains no mascot, no person, no figure, no silhouette, no hands and no reflection of anyone in the glass — the character sheet does not apply here; the empty room itself is the subject. SIZE: the full-height window wall and the city beyond it are the largest thing in the frame, running edge to edge across the entire upper five-eighths, divided into tall panels by thick dark vertical mullions; the notice sheet on the side table is drawn far larger than real proportion would allow so its heading reads instantly at thumbnail size. Scene: the living room of an ordinary high-floor Korean apartment, drawn from inside at seated eye level, square on to the glass and looking straight out. Beyond the window a wide river bends through a dense city at dusk — the sky burns orange and violet low over distant hills while the bridges, apartment blocks and one tall lit tower below glow in cold white and blue, every light a small solid bead. Inside, a recessed cove strip runs along the ceiling and floods the plain plaster in warm amber; a low bookshelf with a few books and a round badge-shaped clock holds the right edge, a leafy potted plant the left, and the finishes are modest and lived in rather than luxurious — painted walls, a simple fabric sofa, ordinary flooring. A wooden side table stands against the glass at mid height, and on it an oversized white window envelope has just been torn open with the notice sheet pulled halfway out and curling upward, its header reading "자격상실 안내" in Korean Hangul in large characters while the smaller lines beneath are drawn too small and slightly blurred to read; the sheer curtain beside it is lifting in a draught and the corner of the paper is rising with it. A worn cardigan hangs over the arm of the sofa, and a cold cup of tea and a pair of reading glasses sit beside the envelope.

thumbnails.concept_ko: [모순] 도달한 자의 전망을 등지고, 그 앞 탁자 위에서는 계산이 이미 켜져 돌아가고 있다 / [남김] 7번과 동일 4개 — 그 한 줄 모순 · 세로 창틀 분할선과 실내·창밖 경계 · 거실 안쪽 앉은 눈높이에서 창을 정면으로 보는 시점 · 인물 0명 + 통유리와 야경이 상단 5/8을 채우는 배치와 실내 따뜻함 vs 창밖 차가움 / [바꿈] 피사체(창밖 야경 → 창가 콘솔 위 실물이 전경 주인공, 야경은 뒤로 물러남) · 화면 안 사물(없음 → 화면의 연 이자 금액과 벽걸이 11월 달력) · 시간대와 광원(해질녘 → 늦은 밤, 스탠드 하나와 화면 백라이트만) ※ 카메라 시점은 바꾸지 않았다. [A 얼굴] ⛔ 없음(001 프레임 재현, 마스코트도 넣지 않는다) / [B 금액] ⭕ "3,200만원" · "2,000만원" — 이 장이 게이트 B를 통과시킨다 / [C 사건] 화면 숫자의 마지막 자리가 지금 넘어가는 중, 달력 장이 반쯤 넘어가 들려 있는 중 / [D 주어] 저 연 이자가 내 것이고 그게 선을 넘겼다 / [구도] 인물 없는 공간 단독 / [텍스트] 001 배치 계승 — 하단 2단, 윗줄 노랑 / 아랫줄 흰색
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the illustration fills the entire 16:9 frame edge to edge — never a letterbox band, never an empty panel, never a flat colour block. The bottom three-eighths of the frame height is filled by the dark front panel of the console table and the deep near-black shadow on the floor below it, with no readable detail, so that overlay text stays legible on top of it; the upper five-eighths is bright, warm and high-contrast, lit by a single amber lamp and the glow of the screen, and crowded with things to look at. No screen, no lamp and no number sits in that bottom three-eighths — every screen, sheet of paper and number sits in the upper five-eighths. The console top runs across the MIDDLE of the frame, never near the bottom edge. NO CHARACTER IN THIS IMAGE: this picture contains no mascot, no person, no figure, no silhouette, no hands and no reflection of anyone in the glass — the character sheet does not apply here; the empty room itself is the subject. SIZE: the full-height window wall and the night city beyond it still run edge to edge across the entire upper five-eighths behind everything, divided into tall panels by thick dark vertical mullions, but they sit back as a darker backdrop; the laptop screen standing on the console is drawn far larger than real proportion would allow, filling about a third of the picture width, so its number reads instantly at thumbnail size. Scene: the same ordinary high-floor Korean apartment living room, late at night, drawn from inside at seated eye level, square on to the glass and looking straight out over a long console table pushed against the window. Beyond the glass the sunset colours are gone and only the cold white and blue beads of the city, its bridges and one tall lit tower remain. Inside, a single floor lamp in the right corner throws warm amber across the plain plaster wall and the modest furnishings. The oversized laptop screen is turned towards the viewer: a header reading "연 이자" in Korean Hangul sits above enormous clean white digits reading "3,200만원" running almost the whole width of the screen, with a short saturated red bar beneath carrying "2,000만원" in Korean Hangul, and the last digit of the big figure is still flipping over. Beside it on the wall hangs a large paper calendar whose sheet reads "11월" in Korean Hangul in enormous characters, the sheet half turned and lifted away from the wall, the date squares below drawn too small and slightly blurred to read. Bank statements, a torn window envelope, a short red bar chart printed on one of the sheets, reading glasses and a cold cup are stacked at mid height along the console.

thumbnails.concept_ko: [모순] 같은 창, 같은 야경을 마주한 한 거실인데 한쪽은 불이 살아 있고 한쪽은 방금 꺼졌다 — 넘은 쪽과 안 넘은 쪽이 한 화면에 있다 / [남김] 7번과 동일 4개 — 그 한 줄 모순 · 세로 창틀 분할선과 실내·창밖 경계 · 거실 안쪽 앉은 눈높이에서 창을 정면으로 보는 시점 · 인물 0명 + 통유리와 야경이 상단 5/8을 채우는 배치 / [바꿈] 공간의 성격(이어진 거실 → 굵은 기둥으로 좌우가 갈린 거실) · 시간대와 광원(균일한 따뜻한 간접조명 → 좌측 소등·우측 점등의 좌우 명암 대비) · 화면 안 사물(없음 → 좌측 협탁의 11월 고지서 더미, 우측 협탁의 정리된 통장과 김 나는 찻잔) ※ 카메라 시점은 바꾸지 않았다. 이 계열 좌우 대비 4장째다(1·4·6·9). [A 얼굴] ⛔ 없음(001 프레임 재현, 마스코트도 넣지 않는다) / [B 금액] ⛔ 없음 — 고지서 헤더 "11월 고지서"만. 8번이 대신 통과한다 / [C 사건] 좌측 조명이 방금 꺼지며 잔광이 스러지는 중, 고지서 맨 위 장이 협탁 끝에서 미끄러져 떨어지려는 중 / [D 주어] 어느 쪽 거실에 내가 앉게 되는가 / [구도] 인물 없는 공간 단독 + 좌우대비 / [텍스트] 001 배치 계승 — 하단 2단, 윗줄 노랑 / 아랫줄 흰색
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the illustration fills the entire 16:9 frame edge to edge — never a letterbox band, never an empty panel, never a flat colour block. The bottom three-eighths of the frame height is filled by the dark backs of the two low sofas nearest the viewer and the deep near-black shadow on the floor between them, with no readable detail, so that overlay text stays legible on top of it; the upper five-eighths is bright and high-contrast — golden amber on the right half, cold blue on the left half — and crowded with things to look at. No lamp, no sheet of paper and no bright object sits in that bottom three-eighths — the window wall, both side tables and every object of interest sit in the upper five-eighths. The side table tops run across the MIDDLE of the frame, never near the bottom edge. NO CHARACTER IN THIS IMAGE: this picture contains no mascot, no person, no figure, no silhouette, no hands and no reflection of anyone in the glass — the character sheet does not apply here; the divided empty room itself is the subject. SIZE: the full-height window wall and the night city beyond it are the largest thing in the frame, running edge to edge across the entire upper five-eighths and divided into tall panels by thick dark vertical mullions, with one heavy square structural pillar standing at the centre of that span and cutting the room into a left half and a right half; the stack of bills and the bankbook on the two side tables are drawn far larger than real proportion would allow so they read instantly at thumbnail size. Scene: the living room of an ordinary high-floor Korean apartment, drawn from inside at seated eye level, square on to the glass and looking straight out; the same river, the same bridges and the same tall lit tower run continuously across both halves of the window at dusk, so it is clearly one single view. The left half of the room has just gone dark — its ceiling cove strip is switched off with the last warm glow still dying out of it, the curtain half drawn, and only cold blue city light reaching in; on the left side table a leaning stack of oversized window envelopes and printed bills sits at mid height, the top sheet already sliding off the edge in mid-fall, its header reading "11월 고지서" in Korean Hangul in large characters while the smaller lines beneath are drawn too small and slightly blurred to read. The right half is still warm and alive — an amber cove strip along the ceiling, a lit floor lamp, a bookshelf with a few books and a round clock, and on the right side table a bankbook squared up beside a steaming cup and a small stack of gold coins. Warm amber and glossy highlights on the right, deep near-black and cold blue on the left, meeting hard at the pillar.
